papers.title_en: EvoLink-Bench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Interdependent Task Streams
papers.authors: Wei Chen, Xiaodong Lu, Weihao Shen, Gongxun Li, Xingyu Guo, Qihang Sun, Fuwei Zhang, Zhao Zhang, Yikun Ban, Shuang Li, Deqing Wang, Fuzhen Zhuang
papers.evidence: 提出用于评估长程相互依赖任务流中自进化LLM智能体的基准
papers.tldr: 现有流式基准多为短序列或彼此独立的任务，难以验证智能体能否在长时程、任务间存在依赖的场景中复用经验。作者提出 EvoLink-Bench，覆盖日常办公、多轮对话与 AutoResearch 流程，任务共享持久工作区并相互依赖，分为 L1 知识获取与修正、L2 任务能力发展两个层次，并区分任务内恢复、持久状态更新与后续经验复用。结果显示，五个框架在两种层次上均无稳定最优，重试仅挽回少量失败任务，持久状态更新未必带来后续提升，且知识层与能力层的进化机制不同。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from passive chatbots into autonomous systems that operate continuously in dynamic environments. Such agents need not only solve current tasks but also learn from past interactions to improve future performance. However, existing streaming benchmarks often rely on short task sequences or largely independent tasks, providing limited evidence of whether agents can effectively reuse experience when later tasks depend on earlier outcomes. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{EvoLink-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating self-evolving agents in long-horizon, interdependent task streams. It covers daily office work, multi-turn dialogue, and AutoResearch-style workflows, with persistent workspaces and dependencies across tasks. The benchmark includes two complementary levels: \textbf{L1}, which evaluates the acquisition and revision of language-expressible knowledge, and \textbf{L2}, which assesses the development of task-level capabilities through execution and feedback. Its evaluation further distinguishes within-task recovery, persistent-state updates, and experience reuse in later tasks. We evaluate five agent frameworks across three backbone configurations under three persistence conditions, covering 19,635 scored task slots from selected evaluation cohorts. Results show that no framework consistently performs best across both levels, retries recover only a limited proportion of failed tasks, and persistent-state updates do not necessarily improve subsequent performance. Furthermore, the effects of evolution differ between knowledge- and capability-level tasks, suggesting that these two forms of evolution require different learning mechanisms. Performance gains also vary across domains and task streams, with improvements on some tasks not necessarily extending to others.

papers.title_en: Failure Broadens, Success Sharpens: Continual Adaptation of Tool-Use Agents Across Diverse Tasks with Dual-Polarity Memory
papers.authors: Tianmai M. Zhang, Hoda Shajari, Amr Hendy, Xiaohu Liu, Piyush Behre, Omar Zia Khan, Ankur Gupta
papers.evidence: 基于历史任务轨迹构建程序性记忆以支持智能体持续自我改进
papers.tldr: LLM工具使用智能体可利用过程记忆持续自我改进，但成功与失败记忆的不同作用尚不清晰。论文在多领域异构任务流中提出DualPM：从局部成功和失败生成反思与过程记忆，并按周期在容量约束下整合记忆，避免膨胀。在线预序评估显示失败记忆拓宽覆盖、成功记忆精简执行，二者结合兼得优势。DualPM还展现跨域泛化与持续适应能力，并在EvoMemBench验证可移植性。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents can self-improve over time by utilizing procedural memory derived from prior task trajectories, yet the distinct utilities of memories derived from local successes and failures remain underexplored. This work studies this question in a realistic setting with heterogeneous streams of multi-domain tool-use tasks and various environment constraints common in real-world scenarios. We develop \emph{Dual-Polarity Memory with Periodic Maintenance} (DualPM), a simple, retrieval-free memory workflow characterized by (1) customizable reflection and procedural memory generation from both local successes and failures within each trajectory, and (2) periodic memory consolidation over long task streams under a given memory capacity, preventing memory explosion. Online prequential evaluation with fine-grained metrics reveals that failure memory more strongly broadens coverage, success memory better streamlines execution, while combining both polarities effectively integrates both benefits. Further studies demonstrate that DualPM enables cross-domain memory generalization and continual memory adaptation, while external evaluation on EvoMemBench reveals the portability and effectiveness of DualPM as a general long-term procedural memory method.

papers.title_en: MedSkill-E$^{2}$: Evaluating and Evolving Skills for Medical Agents
papers.authors: Jingjing Hua, Shaocong Wei, Jianghan Shen, Junzhi Ning, Min Cen, Cheng Tang, Ziyan Huang, Jiepeng Li, Fengshuo Liu, Kangkun Mao, Mouxiao Bian, Yirong Chen, Ming Hu, Jiyao Liu
papers.evidence: 提出用于评估医学语言智能体技能使用的EBU-Bench基准
papers.tldr: 针对医疗智能体“技能可用却未被充分利用”（EBU）的问题，作者提出MedSkill-E²评估与演化框架，并构建覆盖12类任务的EBU-Bench。该框架量化自主使用与显式指导下的技能使用准确率差距，并提出EBU-Evolve将执行反馈蒸馏为可复用技能指令。实验显示所有模型-框架组合均存在EBU，平均差距43.94个百分点；演化后自主使用准确率提升33.33至55.17个百分点并可跨模型、跨框架迁移。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use skills to access domain knowledge and complete real-world tasks. We observe that even when a skill specifies the rules and procedures needed for a task, agents may fail to apply them effectively during autonomous execution, a phenomenon we call skill Enable But Underuse (EBU). This issue is particularly consequential in medical tasks, where overlooking a single critical constraint can yield a plausible but incorrect result. To evaluate and address EBU, we introduce MedSkill-E$^{2}$, a framework for evaluating and evolving skills for medical agents. We construct EBU-Bench, a challenging benchmark covering 12 medically relevant task groups and associated skills, to evaluate agents' ability to use available skills autonomously. We quantify the EBU gap as the difference in skill-use accuracy between autonomous use and explicitly guided reading and application of the same skill. On EBU-Bench, all evaluated model-harness combinations exhibit EBU, with a mean gap of 43.94 percentage points (pp). For the same model, skill-use accuracy under autonomous use differs by up to 38.96 pp across harnesses. Motivated by these observations, we propose EBU-Evolve, which uses execution feedback from autonomous and explicitly guided skill use to distill effective guidance into reusable skill instructions. Relative to their pre-evolution versions, the revised skills improve skill-use accuracy during autonomous execution by 33.33 to 55.17 pp and continue to yield improvements when transferred across multiple models and harnesses. Our results show that autonomous skill-use accuracy varies across harnesses with the model and skill held fixed, and model rankings can change. EBU can persist even after a skill is opened. EBU-Evolve improves autonomous skill-use accuracy on unseen tasks within the same skill, with gains transferring across models and harnesses.

papers.title_en: EgoUseBench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents under Evolving First-Person Contexts
papers.authors: Yurun Chen, Biao Yi, Qihang Yu, Keting Yin, Shengyu Zhang
papers.evidence: 评估计算机使用智能体的基准
papers.tldr: 智能眼镜等AI可穿戴设备让计算任务源于用户第一视角活动，但视角受限与观察不全会造成上下文和意图歧义。论文提出EgoUseBench，基于74小时真实第一视角录制构建693个任务，覆盖显式指令、离线与在线Ego Use三种设置，并按Graft、Refresh、Clarify刻画执行中的信息演化。评测显示先进模型在线Ego Use成功率比Computer-Use低26.3%，暴露持续对齐演化上下文与用户意图的难点，为相关智能体评测提供基准。
papers.abstract_en: AI wearables, such as smart glasses, extend the context available to agents beyond digital environments to users' physical surroundings. With these devices, computer tasks can originate from users' ongoing activities rather than solely from explicit instructions. Through first-person observations, agents can identify objects and activities relevant to user requests and ground digital tasks in the surrounding context. We call this interaction paradigm Ego Use. However, first-person observations are limited by the wearer's viewpoint and may provide incomplete or ambiguous evidence of ongoing activities. As new observations arrive, agents may need to revise their understanding of the physical context and user intent, and reassess whether prior digital actions remain valid. Whether current agents can reliably handle these changes remains insufficiently evaluated. We introduce EgoUseBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ego Use across three interaction settings with different levels of first-person context. Computer-Use relies on explicit instructions, Offline Ego Use provides prerecorded first-person context before execution, and Online Ego Use provides continuous observations as user intent evolves. Based on over 74 hours of real-world first-person recordings, we construct 693 tasks across the three interaction settings. To capture task evolution, we track first-person observations, user requirements, and website state separately. We further group tasks by how information changes during execution, resulting in three types: Graft (revised user requirements), Refresh (new first-person observations), and Clarify (agent-initiated information seeking). We evaluate advanced models and find that average success rates in Online Ego Use are 26.3% lower than in Computer-Use. This result reveals the difficulty of keeping task execution aligned with evolving first-person context and user intent.

papers.title_en: CoEvoBench: Can LLMs Drive Recursive Co-Evolution of Agentic Systems?
papers.authors: Chuan Xiao, Baojie Wang, Haizhao Fan, Hongzhe Du, Xander Xu
papers.evidence: 在五个领域评估LLM驱动智能体系统协同进化的基准
papers.tldr: LLM智能体性能取决于模型与harness，但现有基准多单独评估后训练或固定模型下的harness优化，缺少联合演化测量。作者提出CoEvoBench，让LLM作为研究者在五个领域中从统一基座与初始harness出发，24小时内迭代修改并提交模型-harness配对到独立测试评分。结果显示最强研究者缩小了与指令微调参考系统逾五分之四差距，交互任务上协同演化成功，但长程编程仍鲜有成功；该基准为递归协同演化研究能力提供受控测试平台。
papers.abstract_en: The performance of an LLM agent depends on both its model and its harness, the code that mediates its interaction with tools and environments. Can LLM researchers drive this co-evolution as a recursive improvement process, deciding round after round which component to change when each change alters the value of the other? Existing benchmarks evaluate post-training or data research with the harness out of scope, or harness optimization with the model fixed, leaving this joint decision unmeasured. We introduce CoEvoBench, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs as researchers co-evolving the model and harness of a target agent across five agentic domains. Researchers start from a common base model and initial harness, train and revise within a 24-hour budget, and submit a model-harness pair that is scored on separate test tasks. Across five frontier researchers, the strongest closes more than four fifths of the gap to an instruction-tuned reference system, and co-evolution succeeds on interaction tasks but rarely on long-horizon coding. These results suggest that current LLMs can make a strong first improvement, but cannot yet turn feedback from an improved system into the next one. CoEvoBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring the research capabilities that recursive co-evolution requires.

papers.title_en: SkillLens: An Interactive Human-LLM System for Diagnosing and Refining Agent Skills
papers.authors: Shuo Yan, Rui Sheng, Xiaoyan Gu, Lian Lian, Chengran Xu, Yifang Wang
papers.evidence: 关联执行轨迹、调用序列与输出以诊断智能体技能
papers.tldr: LLM 智能体依赖可复用技能，但技能维护需把版本修改与行为变化、任务结果关联起来，现有流程却将版本、评测用例与执行轨迹割裂。SkillLens 以交互式人-LLM 系统整合性能变化、用例迁移、技能差异、调用序列、轨迹与输出，并保留人工审核。20 人被试实验显示其诊断与改进技能更易用、负担更低，凸显跨版本证据关联与人工审核细化技能的价值。
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, yet maintaining them requires developers to connect revisions with changes in behavior and task outcomes. Existing workflows fragment evidence across versions, evaluation cases, and execution traces. We present SkillLens, an interactive human-LLM system for diagnosing and refining agent skills. A formative study with five developers and researchers identified challenges in prioritizing failures, reconstructing case-level evidence, and preserving context across revisions. SkillLens links performance changes, case transitions, skill diffs, invocation sequences, traces, and outputs in a recoverable workflow, while keeping model-generated explanations and refinements under human review. Through a between-subjects user study with 20 participants, we show that SkillLens supports developers in diagnosing and refining agent skills through a more usable and less demanding workflow than the baseline. These findings highlight the value of linking version comparisons, case-level evidence, and human-reviewed refinement across skill iterations.

papers.authors: Javier Movellan, Manjot Bilkhu, Young-mok Jung, Sirajul Salekin, Henry Tran, Zhao Huang
papers.evidence: 面向检索增强生成的贝叶斯检索模型
papers.tldr: RAG常按语义相似度排序记忆片段，反馈改进多为启发式且缺乏最优性解释。BRAG将检索建模为带使用的生成模型：片段用锚定原嵌入的von Mises-Fisher混合生成可答查询，并维护随时间漂移的潜在效用，用闭式滤波在线更新。在旧片段被新片段取代的长期记忆基准上，BRAG召回率0.80-0.86，优于基线0.67-0.71；个人代理记忆Recall@5由0.75升至0.98。它统一解释查询平均、Rocchio、NUDGE和LADER等特例，并将检索表述为控制问题。
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) ranks memory chunks by semantic similarity to the query. Many methods improve on this by learning from feedback on what was retrieved, but each is a separate heuristic, with no account of when it is the right choice. We introduce BRAG, a generative model of retrieval with use. Each chunk generates the queries it answers from a mixture of von Mises-Fisher components anchored at its original embedding, and each chunk has a latent utility that drifts over time. The model gives the optimal inference, a closed-form filter that stores a few keys and two scalars per chunk and updates them online from the labels of a curator, and it frames retrieval as a control problem. It also shows when existing methods are optimal. Query averaging, Rocchio-style feedback and frequency reranking are special cases with fixed parameters, NUDGE is the case of one key per chunk with no dynamics, and LADER the limit of one key per past query. On two public long-term memory benchmarks, BRAG matches these methods on queries asked before, as expected, because when nothing changes over time the assumptions behind these special cases hold. On harder problems, where a new chunk makes an old one obsolete, BRAG outscores them. They all stay at plain-search level (Recall@5 0.67-0.71), while BRAG retrieves the new chunk 0.80-0.86 of the time. We also ran BRAG on three of NUDGE's seven text benchmarks, and it matches or beats NUDGE on all three. On nine months of a personal agent's memory (20,640 chunks), BRAG raises Recall@5 on held-out queries from 0.75 to 0.98 and Recall@1 from 0.44 to 0.97, with little change on chunks never queried.

papers.title_en: OmniEVIE: Evidence-Vector-Informed Embedding for Multi-modal Retrieval
papers.authors: Zifei Wang, Wei Wen, Qiang Ji, Qian-Wen Zhang, Ruizhi Qiao, He Liu, Xing Sun, Qiang Lin
papers.evidence: 压缩多向量索引与粗、中、精三级检索的高效向量检索方法
papers.tldr: 多模态检索需要同时处理长文档、细粒度实体、有序视频和智能体工具，但单向量嵌入会丢失局部证据，交叉编码器在线重读代价高，未压缩的 late interaction 又难以大规模服务。OmniEVIE 提出 4.5B 多向量嵌入模型，每条记录最多存 128 个 64 维 int8 向量（约 9.5KB），用均值向量、1-bit 符号和 int8 多向量支撑粗、中、精三级检索，并定位到页面区域或视频区间。训练、合并、索引与检索协同设计，配合三级证据校验、动态采样、ST-HAC 压缩和参数块合并。在 MMEB-V3 得 60.06（压缩索引），1M/5M 记录单线程查询仅 54.2ms/120.2ms，比精确 4096 维单向量搜索快 11.1x/25.3x。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal retrieval must match dense pages, fine-grained entities, ordered video, and agent tools and memory. Single-vector embeddings lose local evidence, cross-encoders reread every recalled item online, and uncompressed late interaction is too large to serve. We present OmniEVIE, a 4.5B multi-vector embedding model covering text, images, visual documents, video, and tools with one compressed index and a three-stage retriever. Each record stores at most 128 int8 vectors of dimension 64 (9,472 bytes, or 8.82 GiB per million records), providing a mean vector, 1-bit signs, and int8 multi-vectors for coarse, middle, and final search while localizing each hit to a page region or video interval. Training, merging, indexing, and retrieval are co-designed: all tasks share one retrieval format, a three-grade evidence check removes false negatives, dynamic sampling follows the baseline-teacher gap, candidates are compressed with ST-HAC during training to match the index, stage-wise and specialist models are merged by parameter block, and a saliency gate with a noise floor refines query scoring. Trained on public datasets, OmniEVIE scores 60.68 (full d=2048 sequence) and 60.06 (K128 x d64 int8 index) on MMEB-V3 (190 tasks), 77.96 on MMEB-V2 (78 tasks), and 62.96 on ViDoRe V3 (48 tasks). On 1M and 5M records, a single-thread query takes 54.2 ms and 120.2 ms (11.1x and 25.3x faster than exact 4096-d single-vector search; 236x and 532x faster than full int8 MaxSim). Video is encoded directly from frames without a parsing model: on QVHighlights (1,083 queries), the peak falls inside the labeled segment for 78.0% of queries and the returned span (18% of video length) intersects it for 94.3% vs. 44.9% random. Weights and code: https://huggingface.co/tencent/OmniEVIE-4B and https://github.com/Tencent/OmniEVIE.

papers.title_en: ConTra: A Training Framework for Effective Contextual Retrieval via Prefix Generation
papers.evidence: 面向向量检索与重排的分块索引与上下文保留方法
papers.tldr: 长文档分块索引会让文本脱离识别性上下文，影响检索与重排。ConTra用强化学习训练轻量前缀生成器，奖励融合冻结嵌入与重排反馈、事实核验和长度控制，索引时为每块生成一次前缀并复用。2B模型在ConTEB与RealContextBench上超过提示式9B基线和PPLX-4B上下文编码器，最高领先3.15分，索引速度分别快7.74倍和2.15倍。该工作降低了上下文检索的索引成本并提升跨负载鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Data management systems organize large text collections for tasks such as finding relevant studies and extracting contract clauses. Systems make long documents searchable by splitting them into independently indexed chunks. Chunking can separate text from its identifying details. The indexing challenge is to keep each chunk independently searchable while preserving the context needed to find and rank it. Existing methods either encode that context in chunk vectors or attach it as a text prefix. Context encoded only in vectors is unavailable to text rerankers. Prompted prefixes serve both vector search and reranking, but are costly to generate at indexing time and can underperform contextual encoders. We propose ConTra (Context That Travels), a reinforcement learning framework for training lightweight prefix generators. Its reward combines feedback from frozen embedding and reranking models with factual verification and length control. ConTra generates one prefix per chunk during index construction and stores the augmented text and its embedding for reuse across queries. To evaluate contextual retrieval across workloads and under interference, we introduce RealContextBench, a benchmark with five application collections and three controlled conditions that isolate the effect of distracting text. On ConTEB and RealContextBench, ConTra-2B outperforms the prompted 9B baseline using Anthropic's method and the PPLX-4B contextual encoder, with a margin of up to 3.15 points over their best overall scores, while indexing short documents 7.74 times and 2.15 times as fast as those baselines, respectively. Post-trained only on ConTEB, it leads the standalone methods on RealContextBench after reranking and is less sensitive than the prompted 2B baseline to random and topically similar distractors. Code, datasets, and trained models are available at https://github.com/SStan1/ConTra.

papers.title_en: HoMe: Toward Practical Harness Optimization of Memory Systems for AI Assistants
papers.authors: Yifei Xu, Li Yu, Zhaoyang Liu, Ce Wang, Sen Huang, Yanyan Shen, Yun Lin, Linpeng Huang, Hong Mei
papers.evidence: 面向AI助手记忆系统的评估驱动式harness优化，结合执行轨迹定位故障
papers.tldr: 长期运行AI助手的记忆系统行为由harness（代码、提示与配置）决定，但优化仍多靠人工，无限制编辑也难保证结构改进。HoMe是评估驱动的harness优化框架，利用会话级记忆版本与执行轨迹定位跨案例共享失效机制，并通过候选门控、冒烟测试、自适应采样和记忆复用来降低评估成本。在LongMemEval-S和BEAM上，每基准仅6次正式候选评估即找到优于原强harness的配置，且查询时token显著减少，提升了实用性与可评估性。
papers.abstract_en: The behavior of memory systems for long-running AI assistants is governed by a harness, which consists of the code, prompts, and configurations for memory construction, maintenance, retrieval, and answer generation. However, optimizing the harness of a memory system remains largely manual, and unrestricted editing alone does not ensure structural improvements. In this paper, we introduce HoMe, an evaluation-driven framework that iteratively evaluates candidate harnesses and derives each new candidate from any previously evaluated harness by editing any part of it. HoMe combines session-level memory versioning with execution traces to identify shared failure mechanisms across cases and localize them to the responsible sessions and harness components. It encourages early structural exploration through candidate gating and reduces evaluation cost through smoke tests, adaptive sampling, and the reuse of constructed memory. We validate HoMe with the open-source memory system ReMe on two large-scale long-horizon memory benchmarks, LongMemEval-S and BEAM. With six formal candidate evaluations per benchmark, after a full initial evaluation, HoMe discovers harnesses that improve end-task performance over the originally strong harness while consuming far fewer query-time tokens. The code is available at https://github.com/agentscope-ai/ReMe.

papers.title_en: SpatialMem: Building Quantitative Spatial Reasoning Agents with Hierarchical Memory
papers.authors: Zinan Zheng, Nuo Chen, Jia Li
papers.evidence: 面向视觉语言智能体的分层记忆机制
papers.tldr: 定量空间推理要求VLM智能体调用视觉专家计算，但现有方法将功能绑定到固定专家，导致工具流水线僵化且难以应对多样场景。SpatialMem用任务记忆记录工具编排、场景记忆记录专家选择，并通过双状态轨迹优化保留成功经验、修正次优路径。作者还构建覆盖室内外与三类任务的MetricBench。实验在多个基准达SOTA，MetricBench较最佳VLM基线提升32%，记忆带来9.1%绝对增益。
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in qualitative spatial reasoning, but remain limited in quantitative spatial reasoning. Current work leverages the VLM agent to invoke external vision tools to perform computation. However, these methods usually bind each functional requirement to a single predefined vision specialist, implicitly resulting in fixed and rigid tool pipelines. In practice, addressing diverse spatial scenarios and tasks demands a broader diversity in pipeline orchestration and vision specialist selection to achieve robust spatial reasoning. However, such diversity leads to a combinatorial execution space, making it challenging for the agent to orchestrate the optimal pipelines and specialists for different scenarios.   In this work, we propose SpatialMem, a memory framework that enables a VLM agent to accumulate tool-use experience and leverage that memory to orchestrate vision specialists to solve the spatial reasoning problem. SpatialMem builds a two-level memory structure, with task memory capturing tool orchestration and scene memory capturing tool selection. It further introduces a dual-state trajectory optimization process to preserve successful tool experiences and refine suboptimal ones. Moreover, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks suffer from quality issues and limited coverage of scene types and tasks. To address these gap, we propose MetricBench, a benchmark covering both indoor and outdoor scenes and three quantitative spatial reasoning tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on MetricBench, Q-Spatial, and SpatilRGPT-Bench, outperforming best VLM baselines by 32% on MetricBench. Additionally, the memory design yields a 9.1% absolute gain over a memory-free agent on MetricBench.

papers.title_en: ExpGuard: Guarding Long-Horizon LLM Agents against Corrupted Experience
papers.authors: Yuzhou Chen, Licheng Pan, Zhixuan Chu, Yunsheng Lu, Yichen Sun, Han Zheng, Yan Wang, Bingyu Zhu, Haiwen Hong, Longtao Huang, Kui Ren
papers.evidence: 长程智能体将历史轨迹蒸馏为可复用经验记忆并进行检索触发的风险评估
papers.tldr: 长程LLM智能体会将历史轨迹蒸馏为可复用经验，但被误导或对抗污染的轨迹会让有害指令跨任务残留，威胁后续行动。ExpGuard在检索触发时结合经验语义、来源与执行依赖构建任务条件异构图，预测攻击与任务失败风险；并用匹配反事实回放生成风险标签，在推理时修复高风险经验并复检。实验表明其能识别风险经验并有效防御经验污染，提升长程智能体经验复用安全性。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents distill past trajectories into reusable experiences. Misleading or adversarial guidance in source trajectories can corrupt these experiences, allowing harmful instructions to persist across tasks and influence future agent actions. Assessing the risks of potentially corrupted experiences poses three challenges: (1) modeling provenance and execution dependencies before experience reuse, (2) learning task-conditioned risk from trajectory outcomes, and (3) repairing risky experiences at online inference. To address these challenges, we present ExpGuard, a framework for retrieval-triggered experience risk assessment and online repair. Specifically, to tackle challenge (1), ExpGuard integrates experience semantics with provenance and execution dependencies in a task-conditioned heterogeneous graph to predict attack and task-failure risks before experience reuse. To enable task-conditioned risk supervision and tackle challenge (2), we conduct matched counterfactual replays of each original experience and its minimally neutralized counterpart from the same task and environment checkpoint, deriving separate risk labels from differences in attack success and legitimate task completion. To tackle challenge (3) at inference time, ExpGuard repairs candidate experiences flagged as high-risk by the graph-based predictor at retrieval and re-predicts their risks before they enter the agent's active experience context. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of ExpGuard in identifying risky experiences and defending agents against experience corruption.

papers.title_en: SkillCore: Internalizing Generalizable Skills via Scaffolding-Removed Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Yi Liu, Changqing Ai, Peijie Dong, Xiankun Lin, Yongkang Yang, Zhezheng Hao, Xilin Xia, Hande Dong, Qiang Lin, Qiang Xu
papers.evidence: 利用真实智能体轨迹数据构造监督微调数据
papers.tldr: 运行时技能能提升智能体表现，但多数用户不会主动调用，导致收益有限。SkillCore 将技能内化到模型中：去除真实轨迹中的技能加载脚手架，同时保留任务上下文与后续动作进行监督微调，并混入少量原生技能轨迹以维持外部技能调用。在无技能评测中，其任务完成质量较 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen2.5-72B 分别提升 54.4% 和 24.8%，并保持技能调用探针与 SWE-bench Verified 表现。
papers.abstract_en: Runtime skills can improve agents' problem-solving capabilities by providing procedural guidance for tasks such as code review and debugging. However, these benefits reach only a minority of users, as most do not proactively invoke skills in practice. We argue that such generalizable procedures should become part of the model's capabilities rather than remain optional external add-ons, making them directly available without explicit skill loading. To this end, we present SkillCore, a data pipeline and supervised fine-tuning recipe for internalizing generalizable skills. We transform real agent trajectories by removing skill-loading scaffolding while preserving the task context and subsequent agent actions, thereby supervising direct execution without external skill content. To preserve access to task-specific skills that provide genuinely external information, we mix these scaffold-removed trajectories with a small proportion of skill-native trajectories that preserve supervision for skill invocation. On a held-out skill-free evaluation, SkillCore improves task completion quality over the base Qwen3-8B and Qwen2.5-72B models by 54.4% and 24.8%, respectively, while preserving task-specific skill invocation on a separate probe and general coding performance on SWE-bench Verified.

papers.title_en: SOARS: System One Assisted Reranking for Agentic Search
papers.authors: Amin Bigdeli, Liye Fu, Fattane Zarrinkalam, Joel Stremmel, Elizabeth Lingg
papers.evidence: 为智能体深度搜索的检索结果重排序
papers.tldr: 深度搜索智能体依靠多轮检索与推理处理复杂信息需求，而检索证据的相关性直接影响下游表现；若在整条搜索轨迹中反复调用重排器，则会带来明显的延迟与成本。SOARS 是一个免训练框架，它用 System One 模型进行快速且校准良好的相关性估计，在每一步一次性完成长文档段落筛选与候选重排，并同时考虑原始问题和智能体生成的子查询。在 BrowseComp-Plus 与 WebShaper 两个基准上，该框架跨六个 LLM 骨干一致提升答案准确率与证据召回，同时减少搜索调用、端到端延迟与推理成本。其中 GPT-5.4 Mini 的准确率从 73.9% 提升至 84.7%，搜索调用从 23 次降至 14 次。
papers.abstract_en: Deep search agents address complex information needs through iterative retrieval and reasoning, where the relevance of retrieved evidence influences downstream performance. Existing rerankers improve retrieval effectiveness but introduce substantial latency and cost when invoked throughout the search trajectory. We introduce SOARS, a training-free framework leveraging a System One model for fast, calibrated relevance estimation. At each search step, SOARS selects query-relevant passages from long documents and reranks candidates in a single call, jointly considering the original question and agent-generated sub-query. Across six LLM backbones on BrowseComp-Plus and WebShaper, SOARS consistently improves answer accuracy and evidence recall while reducing search calls, end-to-end latency, and inference cost. On BrowseComp-Plus, it improves GPT-5.4 Mini's accuracy from 73.9% to 84.7% while reducing search calls from 23 to 14, demonstrating the potential of System One reranking for more effective and efficient deep search.

papers.title_en: CypherMAS: Benchmarking Routing Reliability in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.authors: Danil Kostromin, Andrey Sakhovskiy, Semen Budennyy
papers.evidence: 隔离LLM多智能体通信与路由的合成基准
papers.tldr: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统评测把通信与开放域任务耦合，难以判断失败源于推理、工具误用还是消息丢失，也缺少对路由冗余的度量。作者提出CypherMAS合成基准，在链、星、二分、环等固定图中隔离通信与路由，让智能体转发加密消息给持解码器的远端同伴，从而以已知最优路径衡量冗余调用与路由失败。在4B到753B的十一个开放权重模型上，小模型路由与工具使用失败，27B以上稠密模型随图直径下降，成功运行普遍超出最少LLM调用数。该工作将通信可靠性定位为多智能体系统独立的扩展瓶颈。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) distribute reasoning across specialized agents that must exchange messages and invoke tools reliably. Existing evaluations typically couple communication with open domain tasks, making it difficult to determine whether a failure arises from reasoning, malformed tool use, lost messages, or forgotten requests. Prior benchmarks do not isolate communication execution or measure routing redundancy against a known optimal path. We introduce CypherMAS, a synthetic benchmark that isolates communication and routing in fixed multi-agent graphs. Agents in chain, star, bipartite, or ring graphs route cyphered messages to remote peers holding the matching decoders; since the optimal route is known, redundant LLM calls can be measured and routing failures may be easily tracked. Across eleven open-weight models from 4B to 753B, small models fail at routing and tool use, dense models above 27B degrade with diameter, and successful runs exceed minimum LLM calls. These findings identify communication reliability as a distinct scaling bottleneck for multi-agent systems and provide a controlled diagnostic for complex multi-agent systems. The source code is freely available: https://github.com/Andoree/CypherMAS.

papers.title_en: ExtractBench Pro: The Long Tail of Document Extraction
papers.authors: Boyang Zhang, Justin Xu, Adrian Lyjak, Eli Stewart, Simon Suo
papers.evidence: 评测十个编码智能体与八种抽取接口的基准
papers.tldr: 现有文档抽取基准对长尾难点覆盖不足，六类高难抽取模式尤其缺失。为此提出 ExtractBench Pro，用确定性生成器按校准难度合成100份风格多样的真实感文档，并定义模式引导的抽取任务。评测十种编码代理与八种抽取API，无系统能在超过61%的文档上完全无错。该基准揭示了长尾抽取的能力缺口，为前沿抽取系统的改进提供公开资源。
papers.abstract_en: We present ExtractBench Pro, a schema-guided document extraction benchmark that tests six challenging modes of extraction underrepresented in existing datasets. It is created following a framework for synthetic document generation, in which deterministic document generators assemble challenging components into documents that are designed to be difficult at a level calibrated for frontier systems. We synthesize 100 realistic documents spanning a diverse range of styles. On this data, we evaluate ten coding agents and eight extraction API configurations for accuracy, grounding, and their ability to perfectly extract documents. No extraction system extracts more than 61% of documents error-free. The strongest general-purpose coding agents, Claude Code Opus 5.5 and Codex GPT-6 Astra, outperform specialized extraction APIs on both perfect-document rate and Value F1, but at a higher cost per page. Among specialized extraction APIs, LlamaExtract spans the lower-cost frontier, with Agentic Plus Max Effort approaching the strongest coding agent on both perfect-document rate and Value F1 at lower cost per page. Our analysis of coding agent traces identifies intelligent image processing and programmatic reasoning, but also failures in applying document-specific definitions and recovering relationships from diagrams. We release ExtractBench Pro and these evaluation results as resources for the future development of improved frontier extraction systems.

papers.title_en: When Rerankers Work Together: Better and Faster Reranking without Joint Training
papers.authors: Yanqiao Chen, Dongsheng Hou, Yuhan Rui
papers.evidence: 研究多阶段RAG流水线中的异构重排序器级联
papers.tldr: 多阶段RAG中，单独重排器的质量并不能决定其在组合中的价值。论文系统研究无需联合训练的异质重排器级联，覆盖词法、单向量、晚交互与联合查询上下文评分，并提出Cache-Pointwise和Cache-Shapley两种轻量语义粗筛器，共享可缓存表示与线性时间单例推理。在NoLiMa 32K上，将其插入CrossEncoder或Provence前可提升答案准确率4.02–9.43个百分点，并加速在线剪枝1.57–1.88倍；Cache-Pointwise与ColBERTv2经倒数秩融合提升4.60点并加速1.36倍。阶段移除对比还揭示不对称性：级联可胜过最终重排器却不及粗筛器单独使用，说明组合收益依赖阅读器、配对与阶段配置。
papers.abstract_en: Standalone reranker quality does not determine its value in a multistage RAG pipeline. We systematically study heterogeneous rerankers composed without joint training, spanning lexical, single-vector, late-interaction, and joint query-context scoring. Two lightweight semantic coarse scorers, Cache-Pointwise and Cache-Shapley, learn from passage relevance labels and share cacheable representations and linear-time singleton inference. Under matched candidates and budgets, we compare cascades with stage-removal references to measure evidence retention, repair and breakage, reader accuracy, and online pruning cost. On NoLiMa 32K with Gemma, inserting these scorers before CrossEncoder or Provence improves answer accuracy by 4.02-9.43 percentage points while accelerating online pruning by 1.57-1.88x relative to the corresponding reranker alone. Cache-Pointwise composed with ColBERTv2 through reciprocal rank fusion improves accuracy by 4.60 points at 1.36x speedup over direct ColBERTv2. The stage-removal comparisons reveal an asymmetry: a cascade can outperform its final reranker alone while underperforming its coarse selector alone. Two readers, a second multi-hop dataset, and three-stage extensions show that the gains depend on the reader, reranker pairing, and stage configuration. These findings demonstrate a practical route to better and faster reranking without joint training and motivate studying stage order, candidate budgets, and rank fusion as determinants of composition quality.

papers.title_en: Privacy-Aware Adaptive Client Selection for Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.evidence: 联邦检索增强生成中的自适应客户端选择
papers.tldr: 联邦检索增强生成需向多客户端广播查询，带来检索负担与查询暴露。PACS-FedRAG提出在线客户端选择器，结合扰动语义画像、证据反馈、时延、负载成本与探索。十客户端选三时，归档端到端基准证据重叠0.372、答案准确率0.287，查询接收方减少70%。但融合重叠上限0.375且准确率低于诊断值0.645，画像扰动不提供机密性，需修正基线与答案级评估。
papers.abstract_en: Federated retrieval-augmented generation retrieves evidence from distributed corpora. However, broadcasting queries to all clients increases the retrieval burden and query exposure. We present Privacy-Aware Adaptive Client Selection for Federated Retrieval-Augmented Generation (PACS-FedRAG), an online selector that takes into account perturbed semantic profiles along with evidence feedback, latency, payload cost, and exploration. In a ten-client setting where three clients are chosen, the archived end-to-end benchmark reports an evidence overlap of 0.372 and an answer accuracy of 0.287. The retrieval-only evaluation, on the other hand, reuses a full-broadcast baseline with a different fusion tie-breaking policy. Rank fusion across disjoint client corpora imposes an overlap ceiling of 0.375, limiting its interpretation as a relevance measure. Answer accuracy is below the fixed-label diagnostic of 0.645, and raw generator responses are unavailable for parser verification. Corrected baselines and a new answer-level evaluation are needed to assess whether quality is preserved. Selecting three clients reduces the number of query recipients by 70%. Profile perturbation does not provide confidentiality of queries or passages.
